sql: SELECT date('2026-08-11','start of month'), date('2026-08-11','start of year'), datetime('2026-08-11 04:05:06','start of day');
SELECT date('2026-08-11','-40 days'), datetime('2026-08-11 04:05:06','+2 hours','+30 minutes','+15 seconds');
SELECT datetime(978307200,'unixepoch'), unixepoch('2026-08-11 00:00:00');
SELECT date('2026-08-16','weekday 0'), date('2026-08-11','weekday 2');
SELECT datetime('2024-02-29','+1 year'), date('2026-03-31','-1 month');
CREATE TABLE s1(a); INSERT INTO s1 VALUES(1),(2),(3); CREATE TABLE s2(a); INSERT INTO s2 VALUES(2),(3),(4); SELECT a FROM s1 INTERSECT SELECT a FROM s2 ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE s1(a); INSERT INTO s1 VALUES(1),(2),(3); CREATE TABLE s2(a); INSERT INTO s2 VALUES(2),(3),(4); SELECT a FROM s1 EXCEPT SELECT a FROM s2 ORDER BY a;
SELECT x FROM (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2) INTERSECT SELECT 1;
CREATE TABLE s3(a); INSERT INTO s3 VALUES(5); SELECT a FROM s3 EXCEPT SELECT 5;
CREATE TABLE c(a CHECK(a>0)); INSERT INTO c VALUES(-1);
CREATE TABLE c(a CHECK(a>0)); INSERT INTO c VALUES(5); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO c VALUES(-1); SELECT count(*) FROM c;
CREATE TABLE nn(a NOT NULL); INSERT INTO nn VALUES(NULL);
CREATE TABLE cf(a CHECK(a<10)); INSERT INTO cf VALUES(1); INSERT OR FAIL INTO cf VALUES(2),(20),(3); SELECT count(*) FROM cf;
CREATE TABLE n1(a); CREATE TABLE n2(a); SELECT a FROM n1, n2;
CREATE TABLE t1(a); SELECT nosuch FROM t1;

PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; CREATE TABLE p(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE ch(pid REFERENCES p(id) ON DELETE SET NULL); INSERT INTO p VALUES(1); INSERT INTO ch VALUES(1); DELETE FROM p WHERE id=1; SELECT count(*), count(pid) FROM ch;

PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; CREATE TABLE p2(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE c2(pid REFERENCES p2(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT); INSERT INTO p2 VALUES(1); INSERT INTO c2 VALUES(1); DELETE FROM p2 WHERE id=1;
CREATE TABLE vt(a INTEGER, b TEXT); INSERT INTO vt VALUES(1,'x'),(2,'y'); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT a, b FROM vt WHERE a > 1; SELECT a, b FROM v;

CREATE TABLE vt(a INTEGER); INSERT INTO vt VALUES(3); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT a*2 AS d FROM vt; SELECT d FROM v; SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view'; DROP VIEW v; SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view';
CREATE TABLE vt(a INTEGER); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT a FROM vt; INSERT INTO v VALUES(1);

CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER); CREATE TABLE lg(v INTEGER); CREATE TRIGGER td AFTER DELETE ON t BEGIN INSERT INTO lg VALUES(old.a); END; INSERT INTO t VALUES(7),(8); DELETE FROM t WHERE a=7; SELECT v FROM lg;

CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER); CREATE TABLE lg(o INTEGER, n INTEGER); CREATE TRIGGER tu AFTER UPDATE ON t BEGIN INSERT INTO lg VALUES(old.a, new.a); END; INSERT INTO t VALUES(5); UPDATE t SET a=9 WHERE a=5; SELECT o, n FROM lg;

CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER); CREATE TABLE lg(v INTEGER); CREATE TRIGGER tw AFTER INSERT ON t WHEN new.a > 10 BEGIN INSERT INTO lg VALUES(new.a); END; INSERT INTO t VALUES(5),(15); SELECT count(*), max(v) FROM lg;

CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER); CREATE TABLE lg(v TEXT); CREATE TRIGGER tb BEFORE INSERT ON t BEGIN INSERT INTO lg VALUES('B'); END; CREATE TRIGGER ta AFTER INSERT ON t BEGIN INSERT INTO lg VALUES('A'); END; INSERT INTO t VALUES(1); SELECT v FROM lg;
